cards.ex: The company offered a generous severance package to employees who volunteered to leave.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'z ixtiyori bilan ketishni xohlovchi xodimlarga saxiy ishdan bo'shash to'lovini taklif qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan bo'shatilganda beriladigan pul va imtiyozlar to'plami.

cards.ex: I always perk up after a strong cup of coffee at my desk.
cards.exUz: Men har doim stolimda bir finjon kuchli qahva ichgandan so'ng jonlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Kayfiyatni ko'tarmoq, o'zini yaxshi his qilmoq.

cards.ex: I try to stay out of office politics and just focus on my work.
cards.exUz: Men ofis siyosatidan uzoqroq turishga va faqat ishimga e'tibor qaratishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Ofisdagi hokimiyat uchun kurash va shunga o'xshash noxush holatlar.

cards.ex: We need someone who can hit the ground running and immediately contribute to the project.
cards.exUz: Bizga loyihaga darhol hissa qo'sha oladigan odam kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ishni darhol samarali boshlash.

cards.ex: The company has a relaxed dress code; you can wear jeans on Fridays.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning kiyinish qoidalari sodda; juma kunlari jinsi shim kiyishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ish joyida kiyinishga qo'yiladigan talablar.

cards.ex: She carefully planned her career path to become a CEO.
cards.exUz: U bosh direktor bo'lish uchun o'zining karera yo'lini diqqat bilan rejalashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun bosib o'tiladigan ish tajribasi va o'qishlar ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: The company culture is very supportive and encourages teamwork.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning madaniyati juda qo'llab-quvvatlovchi va jamoaviy ishni rag'batlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyadagi umumiy qadriyatlar, e'tiqodlar va xatti-harakatlar.

cards.ex: Their innovative technology gives them a competitive edge in the market.
cards.exUz: Ularning innovatsion texnologiyasi ularga bozorda raqobat ustunligini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatchilarga nisbatan ustunlik beruvchi omil.

cards.ex: The company is undergoing a major restructuring to improve efficiency.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya samaradorlikni oshirish uchun katta qayta qurishni boshidan kechirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning tuzilmasini o'zgartirish jarayoni.

cards.ex: I have my performance review next week with my manager.
cards.exUz: Kelasi hafta menejerim bilan ish faoliyatimni baholash uchrashuvim bor.
cards.uzDef: Xodimning ishini baholash jarayoni.

cards.ex: There's a steep learning curve when you first start, but you'll get the hang of it.
cards.exUz: Boshida o'rganish davri qiyin, lekin siz o'rganib olasiz.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani o'rganish uchun kerak bo'ladigan vaqt va harakat.

cards.ex: He took the initiative and reorganized the filing system.
cards.exUz: U tashabbusni o'z qo'liga oldi va hujjatlarni saqlash tizimini qayta tashkil qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z-o'zidan ishni boshlash va harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit under the weather, so I'm working from home today.
cards.exUz: O'zimni biroz xasta his qilyapman, shuning uchun bugun uyda ishlayman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini kasal yoki xasta his qilmoq.

cards.ex: Women in this industry still face a glass ceiling.
cards.exUz: Ushbu sohadagi ayollar hali ham shisha shiftga duch kelishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarilishga to'sqinlik qiluvchi ko'rinmas to'siq.

cards.ex: The new regulations level the playing field for smaller businesses.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar kichik biznes uchun o'yin maydonini tenglashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat, imkoniyatlar, sharoitlar majmui.

cards.ex: This internship could be a stepping stone to a great career.
cards.exUz: Ushbu amaliyot ajoyib karera uchun tramplin bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Katta maqsadga erishishda yordam beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: The company is trying to increase its market share.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'zining bozor ulushini oshirishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning bozordagi umumiy savdo hajmida tutgan o'rni.

cards.ex: We had a productive brainstorming session this morning.
cards.exUz: Biz bugun ertalab samarali g'oyalar sessiyasini o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: G'oyalarni birgalikda muhokama qilish va yaratish uchun o'tkaziladigan uchrashuv.

cards.ex: Please submit your reports by close of play today.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, hisobotlaringizni bugun ish kunining oxirigacha topshiring.
cards.uzDef: Ish kunining oxiri; ish vaqti tugashi.

cards.ex: It takes a little while to get the hang of the new software.
cards.exUz: Yangi dasturni o'rganib olish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qanday ishlashini tushunish va uddalash.

cards.ex: He had to pull some strings to get the project approved.
cards.exUz: Loyiha tasdiqlanishi uchun u ba'zi aloqalardan foydalanishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ta'sirni ishlatish, aloqalardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: The deal fell through, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Bitim amalga oshmadi, shuning uchun biz boshiga qaytdik.
cards.uzDef: Boshidan boshlashga majbur bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Can I run my proposal by you before I send it to the client?
cards.exUz: Mijozga yuborishdan oldin taklifimni siz bilan muhokama qilsam bo'ladimi?
cards.uzDef: Fikringizni yoki rejangizni kimdir bilan muhokama qilmoq.

cards.ex: Let's take this discussion offline; it's not relevant to everyone.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu muhokamani keyinroq shaxsiy tarzda o'tkazamiz; bu hammaga tegishli emas.
cards.uzDef: Keyinroq shaxsiy tarzda muhokama qilish.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the progress of the project.
cards.exUz: Loyiha jarayonini muhokama qilish uchun kelasi hafta bog'lanib turamiz.
cards.uzDef: Aloqada bo'lish; fikr almashish.

cards.ex: If we don't invest in new technology, we'll fall behind the curve.
cards.exUz: Agar biz yangi texnologiyalarga sarmoya kiritmasak, biz ortda qolamiz.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatchilardan yoki sohadagi tendensiyalardan ortda qolmoq.

cards.ex: The new regulations are designed to create a level playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar barcha biznes uchun teng sharoit yaratishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va teng sharoitlar.

cards.ex: In a small company, you often have to wear many hats.
cards.exUz: Kichik kompaniyada siz ko'pincha ko'p vazifalarni bajarishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir nechta turli xil vazifalarni bajarish.

cards.ex: Our value proposition is to provide high-quality service at a competitive price.
cards.exUz: Bizning qiymat taklifimiz raqobatbardosh narxda yuqori sifatli xizmat ko'rsatishdir.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning mijozlarga taklif qiladigan qiymati.

cards.ex: We've been burning the midnight oil to finish this project on time.
cards.exUz: Biz bu loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun kechgacha ishladik.
cards.uzDef: Kechgacha yoki tun bo'yi ishlash.
